text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 3% over the past day, with Bitcoin holding 58% dominance as smaller altcoins decline in lockstep, suggesting broad-based selling rather than rotation. The Fear & Greed index sits at 12 (extreme fear) and has deteriorated by 8 points over a week, indicating sentiment has sharply darkened despite relatively modest volume at $83B—a signal that conviction behind the move may be limited. This combination of synchronized losses, climbing dominance, and extreme fear typically precedes either capitulation or stabilization, though the low volume leaves room for either direction.
